notes: InfiniteTalk on Wan 2.1 I2V 14B (fp8) + the lightx2v step-distill LoRA, ComfyUI core nodes (WanInfiniteTalkToVideo + ModelPatchLoader): the character of the reference image sings or speaks the audio clip at 25 fps for as long as the line lasts. The first generation is `length` frames (81 = 3.24 s); comfy_driver.expand_talk_chunks chains extensions that continue from the frames made so far (the last `motion_frames` as motion context, the audio window following on) and joins them without the repeated context frames, the way the official video_wan2_1_infinitetalk.json template does. For long lines and whole verses; S2V (wan22_s2v) stays the faster choice for a few seconds.
